messages:
zoe (Design): dropped a new mock for the rollout scrubber + history panel. goal: let folks quickly scrub traffic % over time and inspect diffs between versions. mock: https://img.redwood.local/rollout-scrubber-v1.png :sparkles:
zoe (Design): two UX questions: 1) should we show inline diff badges on each timeline node (tiny red/green dots) or keep diffs inside the right-side details panel? 2) labeling for A/B branches: use 'experiment' or "variant"?
rahul (PM): prefer keeping timeline uncluttered — small timeline badges only for health (ok/warn/critical). full diff in details panel when you click a node. on naming: "variant" feels more neutral and aligns with our experiment API.
tess (Eng): tech constraints: rendering diffs inline for every node is expensive, especially when we have 100+ versions in history. details panel lazy-loads diffs and we can cache. also: scrubber needs to throttle re-renders while dragging — debounce 50ms.
mina (A11y): scrubber keyboard support notes: arrow keys should move by 1% when focused, shift+arrow by 10%. for screen reader users expose a live textbox "Scrubber position: 30 percent" and controls with aria-labels. avoid auto-play announcements; only announce when drag ends or when user presses enter to "apply" scrubber position.
samira (UX Research): we've run a small interview set — users liked seeing a compact sparkline of latency above each node. they were confused by the word "experiment" (thought A/B implied internal testing), so "variant" is better. folks want a clear undo path if they bump traffic by mistake.
zoe (Design): good notes. thinking of adding an 'undo window' microcopy: "You can undo this change for 5 minutes" next to the confirm. ok?
rahul (PM): yes — but make it optional via flag for enterprise installs where policies might differ. also make the window configurable in settings.
tess (Eng): confirmation flow: we should have a two-step toast + banner for big jumps (>25% change) so operators don't accidentally push massive traffic. also record audit event with previous % and user.
mina (A11y): confirm button text: avoid generic "Confirm" — use specific actions like "Apply 30% traffic to v3.1". that improves context for assistive tech.
deploy-bot: rollout v3.1 canary started  traffic 5% at 1912345678
zoe (Design): action items: 1) timeline badges = health-only; diffs in details panel; 2) use "variant" in all copy; 3) add keyboard scrubber behavior & aria-live rules per mina; 4) add undo copy and configurable window; 5) tess to prototype debounce/audit events. i'll update mock and post new link by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
rahul (PM): thanks everyone. can we add a small note in the mock about "undo available for 5 minutes" being editable in settings?
zoe (Design): will do.
tess (Eng): will prototype debounce and share perf numbers in #eng-runtime tomorrow morning.
mina (A11y): will run quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass once new mock is posted.
samira (UX Research): i'll add a short script to test undo comprehension in next round.
zoe (Design): awesome, closing for now.
